title: Freática · el agua contenida en el motor
description: The contained water of Emilie's ánima in the effects lab over a fight at the campsite (?fxlab, src/freatica-fx.ts, src/freatica-lab.ts; docs/animas/freatica/README.md § Look and interface, docs/animas/README.md § Agua contenida). Every foe has its own cell: a straight prism with a staff gauge, water that wells up to three marks and whose colour is its depth, the current, the steam, the sinking and the cells breaking; then each of the ánima's skills as it shows on them (Recarga, Sondeo eléctrico, Bombeo, Riada, Golpe de ariete) and its definitiva, Bajo cero: the ice, its cracks, its break and its turns. Only the look, never a fight's numbers. Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: Every foe has its own cell. Each draws itself in round its foe (its floor, its uprights, its top, then the gauge) and the water wells up from the ground, a mark at a time: one foe is taken to III, over its head and blue, where it is sunk and lets go of bubbles; the other is left at I, to the ankles and green
Agua I on both: a film of green water to the ankles, her model's mesh on the surface
Agua II: to the waist. The column goes from green at the surface to blue below
Agua III, Hundidos: the surface a hand over each head, the gauges' three marks lit, strings of bubbles
Each its own water: one sunk at III, the other at I. Each gauge reads its own foe

Corriente: a bolt on one foe runs through every foe that has water and stays in each one's: arcs skate over the surfaces and along the edges, and every two seconds the water flickers and sparks jump. The deeper water carries more of it
Both waters carrying current, each at its own level

Vapor: fire on a foe's water. The slab between its surface and the mark below flashes white and goes up as steam; its water is a mark lower at once and a cloud stays over it. The other foe's water is untouched
After the steam: that water a mark lower, a notch on its gauge where it stood

steps.eval: window.freaticaLab.fx.clear(); window.freaticaLab.fx.set(2, window.freaticaLab.fx.foes()[0]); window.freaticaLab.fx.set(1, window.freaticaLab.fx.foes()[1]); window.freaticaLab.fx.setRate(10)

steps.caption: The surface is the clock (ten times as fast here), each water its own: within a mark it sinks from full to the mark's tick, the pointer riding it down the gauge; the edge blinks at the end and it drops to the mark below, and from the first it drains out

steps.eval: window.freaticaLab.fx.setRate(1); window.freaticaLab.fx.clear(); window.freaticaLab.fx.set(3, window.freaticaLab.fx.foes()[0]); window.freaticaLab.fx.set(2, window.freaticaLab.fx.foes()[1])

steps.caption: The cells break (whoever held them has fallen): the edges go out from the top, the water falls and runs out over the floor
The first round: the cells' edges and gauges in grey. The water is the same in both
Recarga: the tape runs out along the floor from whoever casts to the foe, water wells up through it and its level rises a mark
Sondeo eléctrico: a bolt from the caster's hands to the foe and down it into its water, and through the other's
Bombeo: the foe with the most water gives a mark up; it runs back along the floor and comes up round each of the party as green beads
Riada: a wave crosses every cell from the party's side, breaking on its foe, and each one's water rises a mark: the foe that had some goes to II, the dry one to I
Golpe de ariete: each foe is struck once a mark of its own water, which is spent: three white flashes through the deep cell, one through the shallow
Bajo cero, the definitiva: one foe has its water at the third mark, so every foe with water freezes, each in a block as tall as its own water stood
Frozen: three turns of ice for the one that was sunk, one for the other. Neither can act
Blows from outside: each opens cracks from the middle of every face out, and at the third the ice breaks in shards. The other foe is still in its own

steps.eval: window.freaticaLab.fx.clear(); window.freaticaLab.fx.set(3, window.freaticaLab.fx.foes()[0]); window.freaticaLab.fx.set(2, window.freaticaLab.fx.foes()[1]); window.freaticaLab.fx.cast.bajoCero()

steps.caption: Each ice cracks on its own: one blow on the tall block, two on the other
A turn goes by and every ice comes down a mark; the one that had two is gone with the second, and its water with it
The whole fight: the party dry on its side, each foe in its own live water on theirs
